pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark regions with sub-rounded corners and smooth pixel-gradient edges. Patch size increases in spatial area from the cervical region to the mid-flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored negative space with consistent pixel thickness. Topological nodes are primarily Y-junctions with clear connectivity across the visible flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated 1D contour along the dorsal neck, formed by individual hair clusters against the background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A horizontal linear depigmented mark is visible traversing two dark patches on the upper mid-shoulder area.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small avian hitchhiker on the posterior dorsal ridge and the partial profile of a second giraffe head on the right edge of the frame.
